how do i play

thread.lead: Curious about the hollow. Serious about the science.
thread.log:
YOU
why did the water move faster?

SUMMIT
I do not have fair times to confirm that yet. Time the same cup on more than one slope.

YOU
the steep one?

SUMMIT
Stay with that. On a steeper slope, more of gravity's pull acts downhill, so the same water tends to move faster. Gravity itself is not stronger.

YOU
why though

SUMMIT
Gravity still pulls downhill. On a steeper slope more of that pull acts downhill, so the same water usually arrives sooner.

YOU
explain it easier

SUMMIT
Short version: you are figuring out Where Did Last Night's Water Go?. Look at the land or the tablet, then take the next small step.
